INSERT INTO "artifact" ("id", "authorAgentId", "title", "uri", "createdAt")
SELECT a."id", a."authorAgentId", a."title", a."uri", a."createdAt"
FROM "artifact" a LEFT JOIN "pieceArtifact" pa ON pa."artifactId" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."id" HAVING COUNT(pa."artifactId") <> 1

label: Store each Artifact producing Piece directly
summary: copy validated producing-Piece provenance onto its Artifact

execute.description: copy validated producing-Piece provenance onto its Artifact
execute.sql:
UPDATE "artifact" SET "pieceId" = (
  SELECT pa."pieceId" FROM "pieceArtifact" pa
  WHERE pa."artifactId" = "artifact"."id"
)

CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_artifact" (
  "authorAgentId" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "pieceId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "supersededByArtifactId" TEXT,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "uri" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("supersededByArtifactId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("pieceId") REFERENCES "piece" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  FOREIGN KEY ("supersededByArtifactId") REFERENCES "artifact" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
